commands: uv run harness stats validate --protocol analysis/freeze/cse-causal-study-v1/protocol.json --purpose power
uv run harness stats validate --protocol analysis/freeze/cse-causal-study-v1/protocol.json --purpose freeze --output analysis/freeze/cse-causal-study-v1/protocol-freeze-refusal.json

cost_at_equal_quality.rule: CSE-5: both must pass or cost claims stay unconditional

decision_rules.primary_rule: one-sided superiority at alpha 0.05 on the pooled Newcombe interval lower bound > 0 with no reversed stratum; otherwise weakened/rejected/undecidable by the #358 rule (CSE-3)
decision_rules.stopping_rule: fixed n from the frozen power analysis using pilot-only control success; absolute floor 10 randomized assignments per arm per agent-system x task stratum (CSE-8); no optional stopping or extension

primary.aggregation: risk difference typed_dataflow - monolithic; exact arm intervals; Newcombe interval; per agent-system x task stratum before pooling (CSE-1, CSE-17)

secondary.aggregation: unconditional session estimands; no at-equal-quality wording unless CSE-5 equivalence passes
dropped unless a blinded rubric is ratified before freeze (CSE-18)

exclusions.deviation_policy: any behaviour-affecting change after registration is a documented deviation record and a new campaign version id; confirmatory data never revises the registered protocol
infrastructure: independent-controller-determined, arm-neutral facts only (CSE-14): host outage, provider interruption before first tool call, launcher crash before the session started
exclusions.rerun_policy: a permitted rerun receives a new randomized id; the original row is retained with its exclusion reason and never replaced in place
treatment_integrity: model alias or CLI drift outside the frozen identity (CSE-6)

hypotheses.statement: The bundled typed-dataflow surface raises the probability that a fresh coding-agent session produces a launching system passing the hidden held-out acceptance within budget, versus the equal-capability monolithic surface.

integrity_checks.gate: MON-1 treatment table and expert parity (#344)
integrity_checks.owner_role: parity harness (blocked: monolithic control surface not built)

seed_commitment.rule: 32 distinct integers in [1000,9999) drawn once from the OS CSPRNG, retained only under ~/aisle-private/freeze/cse-causal-study-v1/, disjoint by value from every committed dev/pilot seed list; revealed after the campaign closes
